title: Serial Reasoning
explanation_script: Which figure completes the row?
Watch the dot -- it hops between top and bottom. The last box is missing.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is B.
The dot hops between top and bottom the whole way through.
So the answer is B.
